name: ArtiSys QA
boundary: Reusable QA platform for web/Electron products with declarative flows, execution profiles, desktop smoke checks, network/concurrency helpers, reusable business packs, evidence capture, reports/history, fail-closed release gates, and optional self-hosted Remote Control. Product-specific persistence, schema mapping, credentials, selectors and installer behavior remain isolated behind consumer configuration/adapters.
limitations: Product-specific persistence, fixture schema mapping, UI capabilities and installer behavior are implemented by each consumer adapter/configuration.
Desktop smoke checks require the executable to exist on the runner operating system.
Persistent demo accounts require a consumer environment/backend that persists between runs; local Electron consumers can use snapshot strategy.
Private cross-repository GitHub Action use requires GitHub Actions access to utilidades or a pinned runtime copy.
Visual regression is disabled by default and only runs with --visual or ARTISYS_QA_VISUAL=1.
Remote Control is disabled unless the remote command is started explicitly.
Remote Control exposes only manifest-defined flow/profile/environment/viewport choices and does not accept arbitrary shell commands.
Direct phone access is intended for a trusted LAN; internet exposure requires a separately configured secure VPN/reverse proxy and is not a core dependency.
The runner machine must remain powered on for Remote Control executions.
Local-only systems require a compatible local runner for OS-specific executable and installer checks.
